title: demo31
content:
Feature: Product Inventory and Shopping Cart

Page URL: https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html (default tab: Products)

Login Flow:

Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/

Enter valid username "standard_user"

Enter valid password "secret_sauce"

Click "Login" button

Acceptance Criteria:

AC1. Product inventory page renders correctly after successful login

- Page displays header "Products"

- Product list is visible with product cards

- Each product card contains:

- Product image

- Product name

- Product description

- Product price

- "Add to cart" button

- Top navigation displays:

- Menu button

- Shopping cart icon

- Cart badge displays item count when products are added

AC2. User can add and remove products from the cart

- "Add to cart" button is visible for each available product

- Clicking "Add to cart":

- Button text changes to "Remove"

- Cart badge count increases immediately

- Product appears in the shopping cart

- Clicking "Remove":

- Product is removed from the cart

- Cart badge count decreases immediately

- Cart icon opens:

- "Your Cart" page

Buttons:

- "Continue Shopping" (secondary)

- "Checkout" (primary)

- Clicking "Continue Shopping":

- Returns user to product inventory

- Cart items remain unchanged

- Clicking "Checkout":

- Opens checkout information page

AC3. Product sorting behaviour

- Sorting dropdown is visible on the inventory page

- Available sorting options:

- Name (A to Z)

- Name (Z to A)

- Price (low to high)

- Price (high to low)

- Selecting a sorting option updates product order immediately

- Sorting is applied to all visible products

AC4. Protected/disabled states

- Checkout button is disabled when cart contains no items

- User cannot access inventory page without authentication

- Unauthenticated users are redirected to login page

- Hovering over locked products or restricted actions shows tooltip:

"Product is unavailable"

User Flows:

Flow 1 — Login and View Products:

1. User navigates to https://www.saucedemo.com/

2. User enters valid credentials:

Username: standard_user

Password: secret_sauce

3. User clicks "Login"

4. Inventory page opens

5. User sees:

- Products header

- Product cards

- Shopping cart icon

- Sorting dropdown

6. Expected product count:

- 6 products displayed by default

Flow 2 — Add Product to Cart:

1. User clicks "Add to cart" on a product

2. Button text changes from "Add to cart" to "Remove"

3. Cart badge updates from empty state to "1"

4. User opens the cart

5. Selected product appears in "Your Cart"

Flow 3 — Remove Product From Cart:

1. User clicks "Remove" on an added product

2. Product is removed from cart

3. Cart badge count decreases

4. Cart remains accessible with remaining products

Flow 4 — Empty Cart Checkout:

1. User opens cart without adding products

2. Cart page displays:

"Your Cart"

3. Checkout action is unavailable or blocked

4. User can continue shopping
